deck.title: Impact of the Internet on Individuals

front_blocks.md: Name the three biggest impacts of the internet on employment.

back_blocks.md: A **change in skills requirements**, **new job opportunities** and **job losses**.

cards.front_md: Name the three biggest impacts of the internet on employment.
cards.back_md: A **change in skills requirements**, **new job opportunities** and **job losses**.

front_blocks.md: How has automation changed the skills employers look for?

back_blocks.md: There is a **shift in the need for particular skill sets**, so employees must be **adaptable**, with a focus on **problem solving and critical thinking** rather than tasks that can now be automated.

cards.front_md: How has automation changed the skills employers look for?
cards.back_md: There is a **shift in the need for particular skill sets**, so employees must be **adaptable**, with a focus on **problem solving and critical thinking** rather than tasks that can now be automated.

front_blocks.md: Name three soft skills that have grown in importance.

back_blocks.md: **Effective communication**, **collaboration** and **lifelong learning**.

cards.front_md: Name three soft skills that have grown in importance.
cards.back_md: **Effective communication**, **collaboration** and **lifelong learning**.

front_blocks.md: Name four new job areas created by the internet.

back_blocks.md: **Cyber security**, **data science**, **artificial intelligence and machine learning**, **digital marketing** and **cloud computing**.

cards.front_md: Name four new job areas created by the internet.
cards.back_md: **Cyber security**, **data science**, **artificial intelligence and machine learning**, **digital marketing** and **cloud computing**.

front_blocks.md: What does someone working in data science do?

back_blocks.md: They **analyse data and extract insights**, which requires **programming knowledge**.

cards.front_md: What does someone working in data science do?
cards.back_md: They **analyse data and extract insights**, which requires **programming knowledge**.

front_blocks.md: Name three areas of work within digital marketing.

back_blocks.md: **Content creation**, **search engine optimisation (SEO)** and **social media marketing**.

cards.front_md: Name three areas of work within digital marketing.
cards.back_md: **Content creation**, **search engine optimisation (SEO)** and **social media marketing**.

front_blocks.md: Why might the internet lead to job losses?

back_blocks.md: Employees who **do not improve their skills** may **not have the skills required** for new work, and if they are **unwilling to retrain** this may lead to job losses.

cards.front_md: Why might the internet lead to job losses?
cards.back_md: Employees who **do not improve their skills** may **not have the skills required** for new work, and if they are **unwilling to retrain** this may lead to job losses.

front_blocks.md: Define **working practices**.

back_blocks.md: Working practices are the **ways in which a person goes about completing a task** as part of their job.

cards.front_md: Define **working practices**.
cards.back_md: Working practices are the **ways in which a person goes about completing a task** as part of their job.

front_blocks.md: What does collaborative working mean?

back_blocks.md: Employees can **work on the same project or task at the same time, in real time**, working together remotely.

cards.front_md: What does collaborative working mean?
cards.back_md: Employees can **work on the same project or task at the same time, in real time**, working together remotely.

front_blocks.md: Remote collaboration allows employers to choose employees from a much wider <u>**            **</u> pool.

back_blocks.md: Remote collaboration allows employers to choose employees from a much wider **talent** pool.

cards.front_md: Remote collaboration allows employers to choose employees from a much wider <u>**            **</u> pool.
cards.back_md: Remote collaboration allows employers to choose employees from a much wider **talent** pool.

front_blocks.md: Give three advantages of collaborative working.

back_blocks.md: **Efficiency**, since tasks are completed more quickly; **knowledge**, from shared skills and experience; **creativity**, from other perspectives and team problem solving; and **morale**, from building team spirit.

cards.front_md: Give three advantages of collaborative working.
cards.back_md: **Efficiency**, since tasks are completed more quickly; **knowledge**, from shared skills and experience; **creativity**, from other perspectives and team problem solving; and **morale**, from building team spirit.

front_blocks.md: Give three disadvantages of collaborative working.

back_blocks.md: **Co-ordination** is hard, since organising meetings and keeping people aligned is difficult; **personality clashes** can hinder progress; and **contribution** may be unequal between members.

cards.front_md: Give three disadvantages of collaborative working.
cards.back_md: **Co-ordination** is hard, since organising meetings and keeping people aligned is difficult; **personality clashes** can hinder progress; and **contribution** may be unequal between members.

front_blocks.md: What does flexible working mean?

back_blocks.md: Employees can **work when it suits them**, deciding **the hours they work** or **working from home**, and the internet also makes **working on the move** an option.

cards.front_md: What does flexible working mean?
cards.back_md: Employees can **work when it suits them**, deciding **the hours they work** or **working from home**, and the internet also makes **working on the move** an option.

front_blocks.md: Give three advantages of flexible working.

back_blocks.md: A better **work life balance**, since work can be scheduled around personal commitments; higher **productivity**, since people work when they feel most productive; and **fewer sick days**.

cards.front_md: Give three advantages of flexible working.
cards.back_md: A better **work life balance**, since work can be scheduled around personal commitments; higher **productivity**, since people work when they feel most productive; and **fewer sick days**.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Flexible working makes supervising and monitoring employees easier.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
**Management** is one of its disadvantages — supervising and monitoring employees can be **more difficult**, alongside weaker **communication** and **isolation** from the social side of an office.

front_blocks.md: What kind of information can individuals keep up to date with online, and when?

back_blocks.md: Individuals can keep up to date with **news, sport and weather** information **24 hours a day**.

cards.front_md: What kind of information can individuals keep up to date with online, and when?

front_blocks.md: How does the availability of internet content compare with television and radio?

back_blocks.md: Television and radio are **broadcast at set times**, while the internet offers **24/7 availability**.

cards.front_md: How does the availability of internet content compare with television and radio?
cards.back_md: Television and radio are **broadcast at set times**, while the internet offers **24/7 availability**.

front_blocks.md: How does the choice of content on the internet compare with television and radio?

back_blocks.md: Television and radio have a **limited number of channels**, while the internet offers **millions of channels**.

cards.front_md: How does the choice of content on the internet compare with television and radio?
cards.back_md: Television and radio have a **limited number of channels**, while the internet offers **millions of channels**.

front_blocks.md: Who decides what content appears on television and radio, compared with the internet?

back_blocks.md: On television and radio **editors decide on content** and it is **held to a standard**, while internet content is **not always edited** and **not always held to any standards**.

cards.front_md: Who decides what content appears on television and radio, compared with the internet?
cards.back_md: On television and radio **editors decide on content** and it is **held to a standard**, while internet content is **not always edited** and **not always held to any standards**.

front_blocks.md: How does the reach of television and radio compare with the internet?

back_blocks.md: Television and radio are **only available within range of a transmitter**, while the internet can be **accessed from anywhere with a connection**.

cards.front_md: How does the reach of television and radio compare with the internet?
cards.back_md: Television and radio are **only available within range of a transmitter**, while the internet can be **accessed from anywhere with a connection**.

front_blocks.md: Name four new ways of learning the internet has made possible.

back_blocks.md: **Virtual learning environments (VLEs)**, **social learning**, **gamification** and **virtual reality (VR)**.

cards.front_md: Name four new ways of learning the internet has made possible.

front_blocks.md: What does a virtual learning environment provide?

back_blocks.md: A VLE provides **online support from teachers and students**.

cards.front_md: What does a virtual learning environment provide?
cards.back_md: A VLE provides **online support from teachers and students**.

front_blocks.md: What does gamification do for learning?

back_blocks.md: Gamification makes learning **engaging and interactive**, promoting **knowledge retention**.

cards.front_md: What does gamification do for learning?
cards.back_md: Gamification makes learning **engaging and interactive**, promoting **knowledge retention**.

back_blocks.md: Streaming of **movies**, **television** and **music**.

cards.front_md: Name three types of on-demand content the internet gives access to.
cards.back_md: Streaming of **movies**, **television** and **music**.

Information published on the internet is always edited and held to a standard.

Internet content is **not always edited** and **not always held to any standards**, unlike television and radio where editors decide on content.

front_blocks.md: Define **social interaction**.

back_blocks.md: Social interaction is **communication with and reaction to others**, and the internet has given users **different ways to participate socially**.

cards.front_md: Define **social interaction**.
cards.back_md: Social interaction is **communication with and reaction to others**, and the internet has given users **different ways to participate socially**.

front_blocks.md: Name four ways the internet allows people to interact socially.

back_blocks.md: **Online gaming**, **video**, **instant messaging**, **social networking**, and **online spaces for work and learning**.

cards.front_md: Name four ways the internet allows people to interact socially.
cards.back_md: **Online gaming**, **video**, **instant messaging**, **social networking**, and **online spaces for work and learning**.

front_blocks.md: How does online interaction help people who feel isolated?

back_blocks.md: It provides **social support** and a **sense of belonging**, which is important for people who feel isolated or struggle with mental health.

cards.front_md: How does online interaction help people who feel isolated?
cards.back_md: It provides **social support** and a **sense of belonging**, which is important for people who feel isolated or struggle with mental health.

front_blocks.md: Give two further arguments in favour of online social interaction.

back_blocks.md: **Connection and community**, since users connect with people who share their interests regardless of location; **expression**, since platforms give space to explore yourself freely; **convenience**, since it needs no travel and works 24/7; and **social change**, since it is a powerful tool for activism and raising awareness.

cards.front_md: Give two further arguments in favour of online social interaction.
cards.back_md: **Connection and community**, since users connect with people who share their interests regardless of location; **expression**, since platforms give space to explore yourself freely; **convenience**, since it needs no travel and works 24/7; and **social change**, since it is a powerful tool for activism and raising awareness.

front_blocks.md: How can algorithms make online interaction harmful?

back_blocks.md: Algorithms can **limit exposure to diverse perspectives** and help **spread misinformation**.

cards.front_md: How can algorithms make online interaction harmful?
cards.back_md: Algorithms can **limit exposure to diverse perspectives** and help **spread misinformation**.

front_blocks.md: Why can social comparison online damage mental health?

back_blocks.md: Users are **constantly comparing themselves to others**, which can lead to **low self esteem and poor mental health**.

cards.front_md: Why can social comparison online damage mental health?

front_blocks.md: Give two further arguments against online social interaction.

back_blocks.md: **Privacy** concerns over where shared data is kept and who has access; **distraction**, since notifications hinder productivity; and **addiction**, since too much interaction can be addictive.

cards.front_md: Give two further arguments against online social interaction.
cards.back_md: **Privacy** concerns over where shared data is kept and who has access; **distraction**, since notifications hinder productivity; and **addiction**, since too much interaction can be addictive.

front_blocks.md: Define **cyberbullying**.

back_blocks.md: Cyberbullying is **using the internet to send text, images or multimedia in order to upset or embarrass someone**.

cards.front_md: Define **cyberbullying**.
cards.back_md: Cyberbullying is **using the internet to send text, images or multimedia in order to upset or embarrass someone**.

front_blocks.md: Give three forms cyberbullying can take.

back_blocks.md: **Hurtful messages**, **distributing upsetting images**, and **preventing participation in online events or discussions**, which isolates the victim.

cards.front_md: Give three forms cyberbullying can take.
cards.back_md: **Hurtful messages**, **distributing upsetting images**, and **preventing participation in online events or discussions**, which isolates the victim.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
The anonymity of the internet means cyberbullies cannot be traced.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Cyberbullies **can feel protected** by the apparent anonymity of the internet, but most online communication is **easily monitored**.

front_blocks.md: What change in digital devices made working from home possible?

cards.front_md: What change in digital devices made working from home possible?

front_blocks.md: Name three things a digital device at home lets a worker do.

back_blocks.md: **Run a range of software**, **access the internet**, and **access online systems and applications**.

front_blocks.md: Give three benefits to an organisation of employees working from home.

back_blocks.md: It can **attract a talented, motivated workforce**, **employ from a wider location** including internationally, remove the need to **buy or rent office space**, remove **commuting and lateness**, and workers **may work more effectively**.

cards.front_md: Give three benefits to an organisation of employees working from home.
cards.back_md: It can **attract a talented, motivated workforce**, **employ from a wider location** including internationally, remove the need to **buy or rent office space**, remove **commuting and lateness**, and workers **may work more effectively**.

front_blocks.md: Give three drawbacks to an organisation of employees working from home.

back_blocks.md: **Concerns about data security**, it is **more difficult to manage and support employees**, **employees might not work as hard**, and there are **complications with payroll** for workers in different countries.

cards.front_md: Give three drawbacks to an organisation of employees working from home.
cards.back_md: **Concerns about data security**, it is **more difficult to manage and support employees**, **employees might not work as hard**, and there are **complications with payroll** for workers in different countries.

front_blocks.md: Give three benefits to an employee of working from home.

back_blocks.md: **No travel to work**, which means less stress and saves money; **more time working or resting**; the ability to **work at a time to suit them**; **fewer distractions**; a **comfortable environment**; the chance to **organise work around social or family commitments**; and **no uniform or business clothes** to buy.

front_blocks.md: Give three drawbacks to an employee of working from home.

back_blocks.md: **Distractions at home** from family and leisure activities, a **lack of social interaction**, and feeling **disconnected from the company**.

cards.front_md: Give three drawbacks to an employee of working from home.

Working from home is a benefit to employees only, not to the organisation.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
It benefits **both** — organisations save on office space and can recruit internationally, while employees save travel time and gain flexibility.
